content.title: About Zcash (ZEC)
content.description: Zcash is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency that uses advanced trustless zero-knowledge proofs to enable fully encrypted transactions while maintaining blockchain transparency and security.

content.title: What is Lisk (LSK)?
content.description: Lisk is the modern money operations platform for businesses. Finance and operations teams use Lisk to run accounts, payments, and approvals in one workspace, moving money across fiat and stablecoin rails. Lisk is built for companies that operate across borders, entities, and currencies, replacing the patchwork of tools they use today with a single platform for everyday business finance. LSK is Lisk's loyalty token. It lives on Base and Ethereum, with Base as its primary Layer 2 network. Over time, businesses will earn rewards for running their money operations on Lisk and for referring other companies, with additional LSK utility rolling out in phases. Live since 2016, Lisk is one of the longest-running projects in the industry. Today that experience goes into a focused mission: making business finance work the way modern companies do.

content.title: PENGU is the official coin of Pudgy Penguins.

From large companies wearing the Penguin, to being featured in ETF commercials, to garnering millions of followers and over 100 billion views, the Pengu has become a cultural icon making PENGU the world’s social currency.

content.title: About Venice Token (VVV)
content.description: Venice Token (VVV) is the utility and capital asset of the Venice AI platform, a privacy-focused generative artificial intelligence network built on the Base blockchain.

content.title: What is NEAR Protocol?
content.description: NEAR Protocol is the blockchain for AI. A high-performance, AI-native platform built to power the next generation of decentralized applications and intelligent agents. It provides the infrastructure AI needs to transact, operate, and interact across Web2 and Web3. NEAR combines three core elements: User-Owned AI, which ensures agents act in users’ best interests; Intents and Chain Abstraction, which eliminate blockchain complexity for seamless, goal-driven transactions across chains; and a sharded blockchain architecture that delivers the scalability, speed, and low-cost execution needed for real-world AI and Web3 use. This integrated stack makes NEAR the foundation for building secure, user-owned, AI-native applications at internet scale.
